title: Block Out Level 1 Walkthrough
summary: Block Out Level 1 is a three-square rotation puzzle. Move black left, lift white into the upper-right corner, slide red aside, and then let white, black, and red leave in that order.

variants.gameVersion: current iOS and Android catalog checked 2026-08-03

boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 1 is a three-square rotation puzzle. Move black left, lift white into the upper-right corner, slide red aside, and then let white, black, and red leave in that order.
landmarks: Block Out Level 1 is a three-square rotation puzzle.
Move black left, lift white into the upper-right corner, slide red aside, and then let white, black, and red leave in that order.
The board mixes Red, White, Black and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: Use the upper-right corner as white's parking space.
Do not send red upward until white has already crossed left.
If the board feels stuck, look for the color with the cleanest path and use that to regain space.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Slide the black square left so it sits directly under the red top gate.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Lift the white square into the upper-right corner.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Push the red square right into the middle-right lane.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Drop the black square down the left side until it reaches the lower lane.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Move the white square across the top and feed it out through the white gate on the left wall.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Slide the black square right onto the black bottom gate.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish by moving the red square left under the red gate and sending it up.

failurePoints: Trying to raise the red square before the white square has crossed the top row.
Leaving black in the upper-right corner instead of using it to open the left column.
